notes: No ETA marketing. All pins must offer a true problem-to-benefit story, direct to official AstraLabs product landing page; first Pinterest app-board post Keepry, followed by cargo-focused Astramate when board sync works.

pins.title: Where did you save that document? | Keepry Vault
pins.description: Your important PDF is somewhere in your camera roll. Keepry Vault brings imported documents, titles and searchable details into one local-first place so you can review the record you need more easily.
pins.buyerValue: Start with Keepry Free; optional one-time Plus expands Vault document capacity when your records grow.

pins.title: Stowage factor, cargo weight & volume | Astramate
pins.description: A cargo weight estimate does not tell you whether the hold volume is sufficient. Astramate brings stowage factor, cargo volume and weight calculations together with visible working for your own figures.
pins.buyerValue: Start with Astramate Free; unlock the wider supported calculation toolkit with optional one-time Premium when you need it.

pins.title: Important expiry dates organized | Keepry
pins.description: Renewal deadlines live in separate calendars while the documents are saved elsewhere. Keepry Validity helps you keep user-entered dates and records together and configure reminders.
pins.buyerValue: Start with Keepry Free; optional one-time Plus expands allowances and supported recurring reminders.

pins.title: Need to check compass error? | Astramate
pins.description: An observed compass reading is not yet a true bearing. Review the calculation steps in Astramate using your entered observed direction and independently verified true bearing or approved azimuth.
pins.buyerValue: Start with Astramate Free; explore optional one-time Premium if you need the expanded supported maritime toolset.

pins.title: Organize reminders and life-admin tasks | Keepry
pins.description: You found the document, but did you record when it expires? Keepry keeps your personal Vault, dates and Life Admin reminders closer together instead of relying on scattered notes.
pins.buyerValue: Try Keepry Free; optional one-time Plus expands supported reminder capacity and recurring options.

pins.title: Quick mean-draft and trim checks | Astramate
pins.description: Forward and aft draft marks answer different questions. Use Astramate's supported simple mean-draft and trim calculation aids to inspect your inputs and visible steps before independent vessel-specific verification.
pins.buyerValue: Try Astramate Free on Android; optional one-time Premium unlocks the expanded supported toolset.

pins.title: Personal records organized by person | Keepry
pins.description: Managing important records for more than one person? Keepry organizes documents, user-entered dates and People profiles so your household's records are easier to review.
pins.buyerValue: Try Keepry Free; optional one-time Plus expands supported People profiles and document allowances.

pins.title: Voyage, compass and cargo tools | Astramate
pins.description: Cargo volume, weight and stowage factor are connected. Astramate lets you check the supported calculation steps from your own entries without hunting through scattered maritime notes.
pins.buyerValue: Get Astramate Free on Android; optional one-time Premium expands the supported maritime toolkit.

pins.title: Your documents and dates, one place | Keepry
pins.description: Your camera roll should not be your only filing system. Keepry brings images, PDFs, expiry dates you enter and Life Admin reminders into one local-first personal organizer.
pins.buyerValue: Start with Keepry Free; optional one-time Plus expands supported Vault, People and reminder allowances.
